Of course I'm a Bloodsaber, you fool! I've just returned from the Plains of Karana where I was reveling in the glory of the Plaguebringer. Now then, since I see that this foolish investigator is with you, I suppose you want me to sign a confession document or something like that? Well, let's have it then!
Your efforts are commendable, but you will not get far. By Coirnav, you are doomed to failure.

My minions. . . my power. . . lost. Impossible. . .
Imagine every debilitating disease in the world stripping away your body and mind. Now prepare to experience that feeling by a hundred fold!

shakes in anger at your defiance.
advances quickly, giving you no reprieve.

falls to the ground causing a powerful breeze to momentarily envelop you.
erupts into flames. 'Foolish mortals! You shall now feel the wrath of the Overlord!'
falls, its bones cracking like splitting timber.

With a cataclysmic explosion the shards of the armor explode, sending ripples of energy through the canyon.  When you turn back to look you see the charred remnants of what once was the mighty Oshiruk lying on the ground.

falls, its stream of energy dissipating into nothingness.

charges its hands as it runs toward you.

takes stock of the situation and attacks

poit....narfnarf...erp!
